title: RecruitFlow: Candidate CSV Cleaner, Deduplicator & Scoring Engine
target_pain: Recruiting agencies and hiring managers waste hours manually cleaning messy candidate CSVs, fixing broken email characters (like corrupted '@' symbols), removing duplicate applicants, and scoring resumes against target skills.
key_features: Robust CSV/TSV parser with automatic column mapping
Smart character sanitization (fixes broken '@' symbols, encoding bugs, and hidden whitespace)
Configurable duplicate detection (by Email, Phone, or Name)
Keyword-based skills scoring engine (0-100% match score)
Instant export to clean CSV or JSON
